name: Ishtaria
tagline: A persistent, federated, Earth-sized virtual planet.
home_title: Ishtaria – a virtual planet of your own
home_lead: Explore a persistent planet with a fully customisable avatar. Every server hosts an independent world; portals connect worlds that have agreed to trust each other.
feat_1_p: The server owns the world and decides outcomes. The client only sends intentions, so balances, inventory and movement cannot be forged.
feat_2_p: No central universe and no blockchain. Servers make bilateral agreements and hand players over through discrete, signed portals.
feat_3_p: Terrain is generated deterministically from a seed. Only the changes players make are stored.
feat_4_p: Server, client, generator, content and protocol are open. Run your own world and tell stories on it with datadisks.
status_p: Ishtaria is under active development. Accounts, character creation, walking, gathering, towns and story datadisks work; first physical landing, sailing and federation handovers are not finished yet. Expect rough edges.
dl_lead: Ishtaria is distributed as Debian packages for Debian and Ubuntu on x86-64. Other systems are not supported.
dl_play_p: Install the client, start it and enter the address of a server.
dl_host_p: Install the server and its tools; it needs PostgreSQL. See the documentation for setup.
dl_req_p: Debian 13 (trixie) or Ubuntu 26.04 (resolute), x86-64, a GPU with Vulkan or OpenGL support for the client, PostgreSQL for the server.
pkg_ishtaria-admin: Text-mode administration of a world server.
pkg_ishtaria-content: Base content pack: species, items, recipes, biomes.
footer_license: Server AGPL-3.0, code MIT, content and documentation CC BY-SA 4.0. Artwork credits are listed in the client.
dl_direct_p: Standalone client builds from the GitHub release. The Debian package above is the supported way to install; the other builds are untested and the Windows and macOS builds are not code-signed, so expect a system warning.
